provenance.split_method: Writer-disjoint partitioning following the widely used IAM Aachen convention: every writer (form) appears in at most one of the train, validation, and test partitions so that no writer leaks across partitions. The partition assignment for each line is fixed and checked in here so the split is reproducible without re-deriving it.
provenance.license_note: The reference transcriptions stored in this manifest are original, general-English sentences authored for this pipeline; they are NOT verbatim IAM/LOB corpus transcriptions, to respect the dataset's licensing. The sample ids follow the IAM line-id naming convention (form-line, e.g. 'a01-000u-00') and the 'image' paths follow the IAM on-disk layout so that, when a licensed copy of the IAM line images is present under the configured dataset root, the corresponding handwriting line image can be located and paired with each reference by id.
provenance.image_root_setting: Image files are resolved at load time relative to a configurable dataset root (the 'dataset_root' argument to load_training_samples or the HND_IAM_DATASET_ROOT environment variable). When the dataset root is absent, the loader can instead synthesise deterministic placeholder line images so the training procedure can be exercised without downloading IAM.

samples.text: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog
A second line written by the same hand here
Handwriting varies from one writer to another
but the words remain perfectly legible
All that glitters is not gold
and not every wanderer is truly lost
Better late than never but never late is better
Rivers know this there is no hurry
we shall get there one day at a time
Knowledge speaks but wisdom listens to the quiet
and answers only when the moment is right
Whatever you are be a good one and be it well
The future belongs to those who prepare today
for tomorrow rewards the steady hand
Courage is grace held steady under pressure
and kindness is strength that chooses to be gentle
